name: Fontesh
original_description:
Fontesh is a font identification tool for designers and content creators who work with Persian and Arabic-script text.

Attach an image that contains Persian text, such as a poster, social media post, logo or screenshot, and ask Fontesh which font it uses. Fontesh detects the text in the image, matches it against its font catalog and shows the closest fonts in an interactive preview card.

What you can do:
• Identify the font in an image and see the closest matches.
• Compare matches in previews rendered with the actual font files.
• Type your own sample text and refresh the previews.
• Open each font's license link before you use it.
• Mark a result as correct or wrong to help improve recognition.

You can try a few images as a guest; after that, sign in with a Fontesh account to continue.

Fontesh focuses on Persian fonts. It does not edit or generate images and does not create new fonts.
